verdict.rationale: The only on-topic support is a thin marketing claim that mParticle connects customer data to data warehousing solutions [mparticle-docs-11] and a generic doc title about forwarding data downstream [mparticle-docs-25]. The documented Warehouse Sync feature runs the other way: it ingests data from your warehouse into mParticle [mparticle-docs-x4], so it does not deliver this story. Missing for 10: documented export of raw events and profiles to Snowflake/BigQuery/ClickHouse/S3, user-controlled sync scheduling, profile-level warehouse output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
